segments.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get started with the Q3 launch planning sync. Our goal today is to lock the launch date and assign owners.
Thanks Priya. Engineering is on track. The mobile app beta passed QA yesterday, but we still have two open bugs in the payment flow.
How long will the payment fixes take?
About a week. I will fix the payment bugs by next Friday.
From the marketing side, the campaign assets are ready. I am worried the press release depends on the final pricing.
Good point. We decided to keep the pricing at twenty nine dollars per month for the launch.
Great, that unblocks us. I will send the press release draft to the team by Wednesday.
One concern. Do we have enough support staff for launch week?
I am not sure yet. Let's revisit staffing next week. Marcus, can you update the release checklist by Monday?
So we agreed to launch on September fifteenth. Raj, please book the launch webinar by the end of the month.
Will do. This is exciting, I think the team did a fantastic job.
